messages:
jade: quick sync 1 1  on the first-run checklist overlay. uploaded two mockups: condensed checklist (left) + sample card (right) vs full sample grid. main goals: clarity for newcomers, unambiguous sandbox language, keyboard-first accessibility.
tom: looked at mocks. condensed checklist wins for scan-ability. sample card needs clearer sandbox affordance. suggestion: tiny pill 'Sandbox' + screen-reader text 'isolated sample workspace'.
riley: agree. copy: change CTA from 'Get started' to 'Try sample' — lower commitment. also shorten inline descriptions to one sentence (~40 chars) and reveal a 2-line teaser on focus.
jade: good. accessibility items for PR: focus trap while modal open, role=dialog with aria-labelledby, cards use role=button, keyboard arrow nav within grid, focus outline 3px brand blue, contrast checks for label text.
tom: CSS mock: ```css
.sample-card:focus { outline: 3px solid #0A6CFF; outline-offset: 3px; }
.pill { background: rgba(10,108,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(10,108,255,0.12); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; }
```
riley: keyboard details: when grid present, implement arrow key movement (spatial) + Home/End. on mobile collapse to single column and allow tab order. ensure teaser text is announced via aria-describedby when focused.
access-bot: deploy-bot: staging build for branch feature/first-run-checklist pushed at 2026-03-23T17:12Z. :rocket:
jade: next steps: tom will add the pill + contrast fixes, riley will lock down copy and aria-describedby usage, i'll open PR with a11y checklist and screenshots. pls flag in PR if anything blocks keyboard QA. thanks :thumbsup:
